verdict.rationale: Mailchimp's documented Marketing API includes a 'Send a Mailchimp campaign' endpoint, and the API is positioned as powering marketing campaigns. That establishes programmatic sending without the dashboard. However, the evidence does not show a campaign-creation endpoint or an endpoint for scheduling a one-off campaign at a set time. The only scheduling mentioned applies to RSS campaigns, and all other campaigns send immediately. Missing for 10: documented campaign-create endpoint, documented schedule endpoint for regular campaigns, setting campaign content via the API, independent or hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end API-only workflow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create and schedule a campaign or broadcast entirely through a documented public API, without touching the dashboard

citations.quote: Send a Mailchimp campaign. For RSS Campaigns, the campaign will send according to its schedule. All other campaigns will send immediately.
Mailchimp’s Marketing API powers timely, relevant marketing campaigns with custom data pulled directly from your app.
The API root resource links to all other resources available in the API.
